references.label: Bonus X bank
references.description: From the right flipper, scrape across the left bank. A clean line can clear more than one target and deflect into the upper Bonus X bank.

references.label: center rollovers
references.description: In Ali, each completion of the top-left three-bank raises Bonus X until it reaches 5x. Standups, return lanes, and center rollovers each add 2,000 to Bonus Score. At 5x, shoot the right-side Collect Bonus eject pocket from the left flipper, control its kickout, and repeat it because neither Bonus Score nor Bonus X resets.
